newsitem.title: USA: Santa Anita shareholder objects to decision. [CORRECTED 22:21 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Santa Anita shareholder objects to decision. [CORRECTED 22:21 GMT]

text.p: Thomas Gamel, a stockholder who said he holds about three percent of the common stock of Santa Anita Cos and is a former director of the company, said Wednesday that allowing the Koll Arcadia Investors (KAI)/Colony proposal to expire, the company's directors "may have compromised the best interest of the companies' stockholders."

In a statement released Wednesday, Gamel said that to forego the proposal, which would have offered $27 a share for 70 percent of the company, while management looked for another expression of interest was a "reckless strategy at best.

In a descending stock market environment, the boards are on perilous ground to not embrace a proposal from a financial group who are major shareholders and whose currency is not dependent on an ebullient stock market."
Gamel said he would carefully monitor any new proposals the company considers, to make certain they maximized shareholder value today and over the longer term.
Santa Anita Cos could not immediately be reached for comment. But when it announced the ternmination of the deal, yesterday, it said it was talking with potential buyers.
(Corrects story to reflect that the proposal Gamel objected to dropping was the Koll/colony Capital proposal, not the Colony agreement terminated April 1)
